question: Are the exact install-command flags for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Pi correct for the current versions of those harnesses?
probes: Web lookup of each harness's official MCP install docs (web search unavailable in this session)
Ask the person which version of each harness they use
resolution: Partly settled: opencode and pi are installed here, and their exact remote-server flags were read from `opencode mcp add --help` and `pi mcp add --help` (both take --url and --header KEY=VALUE, opencode also --global). Codex and Claude Code are not installed and web search was cancelled, so their snippets use the well-known documented forms (--bearer-token-env-var for Codex; --transport http plus --header for Claude Code) and remain an estimate until a harness or docs can confirm them.
